text:
deploy-bot: kickoff: deploying release-3.0.1 -> dedicated-pool-eu (20% traffic) at 7133337770. Monitoring latency, error-rate, and mem-pressure. autopilot mode=off for dedicated-pool (manual intervention required).
laura: noticed error-rate on dedicated hosts spike ~2% at 7133337776, correlates with high memory growth on model-server. dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/dedicated/3.0.1
sam: can you dump logs for host-3? small sample?
clare: pulling logs now. snippet: `OOMWarning: kv_cache exceeded soft limit` repeated across 3 replicas. looks like quantized model path maybe pressing eviction policy.
laura: thanks. since autopilot is off for dedicated, we need a manual plan. options: 1) immediate rollback of dedicated pool to 2.9.x 2) pin dedicated to older image and keep hosted on 3.0.1 3) scale dedicated pool down and route traffic to hosted (not ideal for customers on private infra). suggestions?
sam: +1 for targeted pin to 2.9.2 for dedicated-pool-eu only. We avoid moving customers.
clare: agree. pin and create internal hotfix branch to investigate model memory path. we should also add a temporary config to lower kv_cache_size via feature-flag.
tim-oncall: we must inform customers in the affected dedicated tenants. ops-runbook says: for dedicated rollback, notify account owners, legal if SLA risk, and change window entry/exit. Can support a draft a message?
eng-ops-bot: created incident RED-7601: "dedicated-pool-eu mem pressure after 3.0.1" and notified #customer-success.
laura: action items: (a) sam to pin dedicated-pool-eu to 2.9.2 (b) clare to open hotfix branch + feature-flag PR (c) support to prepare customer note (d) tim to update release tracking page and change window. ack?
sam: ack. running: `redwoodctl versions pin --scope=dedicated-pool-eu --version=2.9.2 --reason "mem pressure on 3.0.1"`
laura: pin command executed 7133337785. please confirm: `redwoodctl show pins --scope=dedicated-pool-eu` -> shows pin 2.9.2 active.
clare: creating hotfix branch `hotfix/dedicated-kvcache-3.0.1` and PR with flag `kvcache.max_bytes=0.75` to reduce footprint. link: https://git.internal/redwood/hotfix/1234
sam: i'll coordinate release notes update: mark 3.0.1 as rolled-back on dedicated-pool-eu, add entry to release notes: "Targeted rollback: dedicated-pool-eu pinned to 2.9.2 due to increased mem pressure; investigating kv-cache eviction."
tim-oncall: support: please prep customer-facing comms: brief note + one-liner for account teams. cc legal@redwood if any SLA mentions.
laura: support draft: "We're reverting the dedicated EU pool to the previous version for certain customers to ensure stability. No data loss expected. We're investigating and will follow up with RCA within 48 hours." ready in #cust-comms.
eng-ops-bot: customer messages queued to affected accounts at 7133337789.
sam: can we schedule a reboot window for the dedicated hosts after pin? sometimes residual memory fragments persist. suggested low-traffic window in 30m.
clare: will prepare orchestrated drain and restart playbook: `drain -> restart -> verify p95<120ms -> un-drain`.
laura: metrics post-pin at 7133337792 show error-rate dropping back to baseline, mem-pressure trending down. good.
tim-oncall: changing release state to "dedicated-pinned" and scheduling postmortem. who owns RCA? clare for infra hypothesis, laura for customer impact timeline.
clare: I own infra RCA. I'll link logs and heap-profiles in the postmortem ticket RED-7601.
laura: final status update: targeted pin executed, customer comms sent, restart window scheduled. follow-up: RCA in 48h, possible hotfix release if needed. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout note recorded: events: pin=7133337785 customer-notify=7133337789 restart-window=7133337790 state_change=7133337794.
laura: thanks everyone. closing thread and moving details to the release tracker doc.
